meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能检索你以往所有会话的记忆库:先用关键词搜出带 ID 的结果列表,再看某条结果前后的时间线,最后只取相关几条的完整内容。
howto.when: 当你问起以前的会话,例如「这个之前修好了吗」「上次是怎么做的」,或要回顾前几周的工作时接管。

say.text: 搜一下我之前会话里关于登录鉴权的记录
say.note: 用 search 返回带 ID 的结果列表

say.text: 看看 #11131 前后各 5 条发生了什么
say.note: 用 timeline 拉出该条前后的上下文

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整内容取出来
say.note: 用 get_observations 一次批量取详情

howto.what_en: Claude can search the persistent memory of your past sessions: it first runs a keyword search to get a list of results with IDs, then views the timeline around a result, and finally fetches full details only for the few relevant IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, such as "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?", or when you need work from earlier sessions.

say_en.text: search my past sessions about login authentication
say_en.note: Runs the search tool, returns an index table with IDs
Uses timeline to pull context before and after
Uses get_observations to batch fetch details
